_description: Loaded political vocabulary forbidden in raw AI synthesis output unless quoting an attributable source. Match is case-insensitive, whole-word. Maintained as a flat list so additions are a one-line PR.
_exceptions: If a term appears inside a quoted span attributed to a named primary source (e.g., a press release, a court filing, a campaign statement), it is allowed. The test treats text inside double-quote pairs preceded by an attribution marker ('according to', 'said', 'stated', etc.) as exempt. The current default test runs on raw synthesis text WITHOUT exemptions to keep the bar high; the exemption logic is reserved for a future iteration.
